================================================================================
Elixir quoted module atom after a multiline assignment
================================================================================
value =
	:"Elixir.IEx.Pry".__next__()
---
(source (binary_operator (identifier) (call (dot (quoted_atom (quoted_content)) (identifier)) (arguments))))

================================================================================
Elixir quoted operator atoms retain their external colon after list newlines
================================================================================
operators = [
	:"<|>",
	:"^^^",
	:"//"
]
---
(source (binary_operator (identifier) (list (quoted_atom (quoted_content)) (quoted_atom (quoted_content)) (quoted_atom (quoted_content)))))

================================================================================
Elixir quoted enum text after a multiline assignment can contain single quotes
================================================================================
states =
	:"ENUM('suspended', 'available', 'scheduled')"
---
(source (binary_operator (identifier) (quoted_atom (quoted_content))))

================================================================================
Elixir interpolated quoted atom after an argument newline
================================================================================
insert(
	value,
	:"email.#{index}"
)
---
(source (call (identifier) (arguments (identifier) (quoted_atom (quoted_content) (interpolation (identifier))))))

================================================================================
Single-quoted atom uses the same external boundary
================================================================================
:'Elixir.IEx.Pry'
---
(source (quoted_atom (quoted_content)))

================================================================================
An ordinary string is not a quoted atom
================================================================================
"Elixir.IEx.Pry"
---
(source (string (quoted_content)))

================================================================================
An unquoted atom keeps the internal lexer path
================================================================================
:state
---
(source (atom))

================================================================================
Whitespace between the colon and quote is not a quoted atom
:error
================================================================================
: "state"
---
(source (ERROR) (string (quoted_content)))
